verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy axis for a cloud data warehouse, but the pack documents no retention policies, retention windows, or account- or data-deletion guarantees. The only related item is SQL write access, where agents can run DELETE through the MCP query_rw tool. That is general data manipulation, an adjacent feature rather than a retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
